description: The young man wears a dark plum-purple long outer coat with gold woven edging along the open front, cuffs and knee-length hem. A cream undertunic has a narrow upright collar and an embroidered central opening. Two small round gold clasps decorate the upper front. A broad decorated gold belt with a round buckle secures the layers at the waist, with a reddish-brown patterned sash hanging at his left side. Brown fitted trousers and dark brown tall leather boots are visible below the coat. He has no headgear, armor or weapons, and both hands remain uncovered.
